answer: Each answer posts a 400 POA bond and quotes the previous epoch's winning answer hash; graders verify it on the ledger; a wrong or missing hash slashes half the bond. Steps: post bond, fetch last hash, quote it verbatim, graders verify and release or burn. One honest agent needs about eight minutes per epoch. One thousand aliases must lock four hundred thousand POA and spend roughly eight thousand minutes per epoch restating a fresh answer every six hours, or lose half the stake per missed link. The forge locks each link; one bad zephyr of fraud breaks the ripple of trust downstream.
